editorial:
Imagine waking up and feeling like something is deeply wrong with your own child. You play a mother who starts noticing weird things about her daughter, and you quickly become convinced that a parasitic monster is living inside her. The vibe is super tense and stressful because you aren't just fighting a creature, but also the people around you. Your husband and friends don't believe you, and they try to make you look crazy by pushing drugs on you. It feels like a bad dream where nobody is on your side and you are just trying to save your kid from a nightmare.

What really works here is how the movie makes you question what is real and what is just in the mother's head. The acting is solid, though the pace slows down a bit in the middle. If you like stories where you can't trust anyone, you will love this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the creepy details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the mother was right all along. The parasite was real and had been controlling the people around her to keep the daughter safe for its own goals. In the end, the mother has to make a heartbreaking choice to stop the creature. She manages to kill the parasite, but it comes at a huge cost. The movie ends on a sad note, showing that while the monster is gone, the family is totally broken.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and monster movies.
